data.body: **[P2] Document the actual chained-invoke frame formats.** The implementation emits request frames as `...:1:value:<payload>` or `...:1:null`, while this normative specification says the payload follows the version prefix directly. It also omits the separate `...output:1:codec:`/`raw:` result and error frame. Other SDKs following this document will produce requests Java rejects and cannot decode Java responses. Align the implementation and specification, and add fixed cross-SDK wire fixtures.
